ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across central surface with high-intensity (white) clusters at distal margins; approximate 1:4 high-to-low intensity ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central region spanning ~70% of the visible surface. High-intensity irregular geometric blobs located at left and right distal tips, featuring internal low-intensity speckling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of approximately 145 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and irregularity on the distal right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite S-curve; proximal convexity transitioning to distal concavity on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups concentrated on the distal tips and lower leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal high-intensity linear disruptions observed in the lower-left quadrant of the ventral fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, deviating from the standard serration pattern.
